sentence: Chillax first. Jorkumcision finds you; you do not find it.

wombos.definition: To calm down and take it easy; a heightened or emphatic form of relaxing.
wombos.example: Stop stressing about it and just chillax for a minute.

wombos.definition: Podium-level precision channeled through the energy of John Pork — an incredibly sharp, decisive, and ceremonially accurate take or move.
wombos.example: That call was made with pure jorkumcision — no hesitation, straight to the podium.
